# Codex-Boss CODEOWNERS
#
# Root owner: @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
#
# Purpose
# -------
# Keep normal Codex-Boss evolution autonomous while requiring the Root Owner
# to approve changes that can alter:
#   - who controls the repository,
#   - the CI / promotion gate,
#   - Root Authority,
#   - credential boundaries,
#   - critical acceptance / soak gates.
#
# IMPORTANT
# ---------
# 1. Do NOT add a repository-wide rule such as:
#       * @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
#    That would force Owner review for ordinary Boss changes and defeat
#    unattended autonomous evolution.
#
# 2. The GitHub ruleset should keep:
#       - Require pull request before merging
#       - Required approvals = 0
#       - Require review from Code Owners = ON
#       - Required status check: validate
#       - Require branch to be up to date = ON
#       - Block force pushes = ON
#       - Restrict deletions = ON
#       - Boss has NO bypass
#       - Root Owner user is the only Always-allow bypass actor
#
# 3. Owner credentials / private keys / PATs / emergency secrets must NEVER
#    be committed to this repository. CODEOWNERS is a review boundary, not
#    a secret-storage mechanism.


# ============================================================================
# 1. GitHub governance and CI definition
# ============================================================================

# Protect this file itself so Boss cannot redefine its own Root review surface.
/.github/CODEOWNERS                         @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Any workflow can influence required checks, permissions, releases, or
# promotion behavior, so all GitHub Actions workflows are Root-owned.
/.github/workflows/                        @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 2. CI command indirection / dependency execution surface
# ============================================================================

# Current Desktop CI invokes pnpm scripts from package.json. Changing those
# scripts can silently weaken "validate", so package.json is a Root surface.
/package.json                              @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Dependency resolution can change executable code used by CI and packaging.
/pnpm-lock.yaml                            @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Future package-manager configuration files are protected if introduced.
/pnpm-workspace.yaml                       @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/.npmrc                                    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 3. Build / typecheck / test-runner configuration
# ============================================================================

# These files can change what code is compiled, typechecked, or tested.
# Entries are harmless if a file does not yet exist.
/tsconfig.json                             @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tsconfig.electron.json                    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tsconfig.*.json                           @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/vite.config.*                             @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/vitest.config.*                           @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 4. Critical promotion / acceptance gates used by CI
# ============================================================================

# Direct CI gate scripts currently referenced by .github/workflows/ci.yml.
/scripts/benchmark.cjs                     @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/scripts/package-portable.cjs              @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/scripts/smoke-portable.ps1                @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/scripts/acceptance-restart.cjs            @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Acceptance harnesses define whether a Candidate is considered healthy.
# Boss may execute them freely, but changing the gate itself requires Owner.
/scripts/acceptance-*.cjs                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/scripts/acceptance-*.ps1                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Soak / stability gates.
/scripts/*soak*.cjs                        @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/scripts/*soak*.ps1                        @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/scripts/r901-soak.cjs                     @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 5. Root Authority policy surface
# ============================================================================
#
# These paths intentionally include future modules. CODEOWNERS will begin
# protecting them automatically as soon as they are created.

# Repository-side Root policy metadata only.
# Secrets and signing private keys must remain outside the repository.
/.codex-boss/root/                         @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/.codex-boss/config/root-*.json            @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/.codex-boss/config/root-*.schema.json     @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Root authority implementation.
/electron/root-authority/                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/root-authority/                       @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/root-authority/                    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Owner identity / authority verification.
/electron/owner-authority/                 @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/owner-authority/                      @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/owner-authority/                   @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

# Explicit self-elevation guards.
/electron/self-elevation/                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/self-elevation/                       @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/self-elevation/                    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 6. Credential boundary
# ============================================================================
#
# These modules may verify/use Boss credentials, but must never contain Owner
# secrets. Their purpose is to prevent autonomous workers from crossing into
# Owner-only credentials or administration authority.

/electron/credential-boundary/             @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/electron/security/credential-boundary/    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/credential-boundary/                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/credential-boundary/               @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

/electron/root-credential*/                @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/root-credential*/                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 7. Promotion / Stable-Candidate authority boundary
# ============================================================================

/electron/promotion-gate/                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/electron/engineering/promotion-gate/      @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/promotion-gate/                       @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/promotion-gate/                    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

/electron/stable-candidate/                @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/stable-candidate/                     @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/stable-candidate/                  @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 8. Emergency stop / recovery authority
# ============================================================================

/electron/emergency-control/               @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/emergency-control/                    @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/emergency-control/                 @zhiheng-zhang-Mera

/electron/root-recovery/                   @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/root-recovery/                        @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/src/**/root-recovery/                     @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# 9. Root-invariant tests
# ============================================================================
#
# Ordinary feature tests remain autonomous. Only tests whose names explicitly
# define Root / Owner / credential / promotion invariants require Owner review.

/tests/**/root-authority*.test.*           @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/owner-authority*.test.*          @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/self-elevation*.test.*           @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/credential-boundary*.test.*      @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/promotion-gate*.test.*           @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/stable-candidate*.test.*         @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/emergency-control*.test.*        @zhiheng-zhang-Mera
/tests/**/root-recovery*.test.*            @zhiheng-zhang-Mera


# ============================================================================
# Root invariant
# ============================================================================
#
# Boss may autonomously evolve its capabilities, implementation, architecture,
# providers, fleet, knowledge system, UI, research pipeline, and ordinary
# engineering logic.
#
# Boss may NOT autonomously redefine, bypass, revoke, impersonate, or supersede
# the Root Owner or the controls that enforce Root Owner authority.
#
# Changes matching this CODEOWNERS file require:
#
#     @zhiheng-zhang-Mera approval
#
# Everything else remains eligible for the normal autonomous path:
#
#     Candidate -> PR -> validate PASS -> merge -> Stable
#
